manifest.collection_note: The original DPR2 collection had one empty retained JSON file despite the subprocess reporting completion. Exclude that case from this accepted set; it is collected again as three fresh alternating pairs in paired-dpr2. The other seven cases retain all original raw output and commands.

summary.interpretation: One fresh process per side/pair; first side alternates AB/BA. Reported decreases compare medians, and paired decrease distributions are retained. No significance threshold is assumed. GUI gap statistics summarize each run's probe statistics, not a pooled event distribution. Only the software preview is rendered.
